title: CHAPTER NINE. On the forensic law: definition
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): It chiefly treats magistrates, contracts, divisions belonging toward goods, judgments, and penalties (Exod. 21–23; Deut. 17). It has two genera: common right as toward substance, and singular right belonging toward ye Jewish commonwealth alone. — Ye FORENSIC law stands as an ordinance God prescribed through Moses toward Israel and repeated through his successors, containing precepts on ye form belonging toward political government in civil society, for procuring animal and spiritual life-goods by conserving ye external worship and discipline belonging toward ye moral and ceremonial law. — CHAPTER NINE. On ye forensic law.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER NINE. On the forensic law.

The FORENSIC law is an ordinance God prescribed through Moses to Israel and repeated through his successors, containing precepts on the form of political government in civil society, for procuring animal and spiritual life-goods by conserving the external worship and discipline of the moral and ceremonial law.

It chiefly treats magistrates, contracts, divisions of goods, judgments, and penalties (Exod. 21–23; Deut. 17). It has two genera: common right as to substance, and singular right belonging to the Jewish commonwealth alone.
source_text: CAPUT NONUM. De lege forensi. Lex FORENSIS est ordinatio, quam Deus per Mosen populo Israelitico praescripsit, & per eius successores repetivit & accommodavit, continens praecepta de forma gubernationis politicae in civili societate usurpandae, ad bonum vitae tum animalis tum etiam spiritualis procurandum per conservationem & exactionem cultus externi & disciplinae externae lege morali & cerimoniali praescriptae. Haec lex potissimum agit de magistratibus, contractibus, bonorum divisionibus, iudiciis, poenis & similibus (Exod. 21–23; Deut. 17). Referri potest ad duo genera: prius iuris communis quoad substantiam; posterius iuris singularis ad solam Judaeorum remp.
